testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/login/verify-forget-password-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Login > verify forget password functionality

scenario.summary: Guest opens the sign-in panel, follows 'Forgot Your Password?', checks the forgot-password page heading, submits a reset request for a registered account's username and checks the reset-link notification.
steps: Open '/' as a guest (storageState empty); header Sign In; wait for the username field
Click 'Forgot Your Password?'; check the forgot-password page heading (ForgetPasswordPageText)
Fill the account's username in the forgot-password form; Submit Request; check the reset-link alert contains passwordResetLinkNotification
stateChanges: Submits a password-reset request for the declared account: the webstore e-mails a reset link to the account (a reset token may be stored); the password is NOT changed and the test never opens the e-mail (spec comment: e-mail validation is a manual step, out of scope)
assertions: Forgot-password page heading has text ForgetPasswordPageText
evidence: Title 'verify forget password functionality' and the step labels (Open the forgot-password page, Submit a reset request) match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: source 2 (keyPath username, masked by key name) is typed into the forgot-password username field (#username, scan usedBy step 7), so it is a real account's username: role credential, alias user. user -> USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store}, preferred.required true on source 2; the migrated test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', data.username) before submitting the request. The JSON holds no password and the test needs none

Masked labels/messages, not credentials: source 1 (keyPath ForgetPasswordPageText) is masked only because the key contains 'password'; the spec asserts it with toHaveText on loginPage.forgotPasswordHeading (main h1, the page heading) -> expected-output. Source 3 (keyPath passwordResetLinkNotification) is masked only by key name; asserted with toContainText on loginPage.resetLinkAlert (the [role=alert] carrying the reset message) -> expected-output. Values stay masked

Store MaxwellsHardware: the spec runs on env.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on (same store as the approved my-account, quick-order and home-page entries)

migrate: no data value to swap; the account is declared and leased through testData.useExisting (the request sends a reset e-mail to that account, so it should be the leased shared account, not an arbitrary one). REVIEW: if the recorded username is not a registered account of MaxwellsHardware, preferred.required true makes the test skip instead of picking another account
Profile: every value NO_RULE or SENSITIVE (no observation FOUND); profiled false
